channel.title: Danil Zanozin Photography
channel.description: Photography field notes and trip guides from the American West.

item.title: High Sierra Trail: A Photographer’s Guide to Crescent Meadow and Mount Whitney
item.description: Seventy-two miles from Crescent Meadow to Mount Whitney with ten pounds of camera gear — our day-by-day itinerary, why walk-up permits beat the online lottery, and why the hardest day wasn’t the one with the mountain on it.

item.title: Grand Canyon Rim-to-Rim: A Photographer’s Guide to Hiking and Shooting Both Rims
item.description: A week hiking from the North Rim to the South Rim with a camera on my back — itinerary, the best light and gear, where to shoot sunrise and sunset, rim-to-rim permits and water, and what the fire left on the North Rim.
